races.name: Happy 70th Birthday Brian Glanville Handicap
races.verdict:
It could be worth chancing NEWSREADER who is on a career-low mark starting out for a trainer enjoying a tremendous season having had a number of new recruits win first time up along the way. Monsieur Patat and Safari Dream are a couple of the likely dangers.

  1. NEWSREADER (IRE)
  2. MONSIEUR PATAT
  3. SAFARI DREAM (IRE)

races.name: EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
AVIONICS took a big step forward from his debut when second at Salisbury and can open his account at the expense of the penalised Perfect Nation, who should have even more to offer after dominating at Lingfield. George Cross is an interesting newcomer, while First Mate could be a big improver.

  1. AVIONICS (IRE)
  2. PERFECT NATION (IRE)
  3. GEORGE CROSS (FR)

races.name: Ken Meredith Memorial Race Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
BIRD OF WAR took a step forward when third at Newcastle last time out and is weighted to double his tally here off just a 1 lb higher mark. Last year's victor Sofian appeals as the main danger ahead of Lerwick now he drops back in trip.

  1. BIRD OF WAR (IRE)
  2. SOFIAN (IRE)
  3. LERWICK

races.name: Ken Meredith Memorial Race Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
C&D scorer KALEIDOSCOPE EYES rates the pick of the weights on the back of a resurgent C&D third (form has been franked) so looks the way to go here. In-form Rosemary's Rose appeals as the chief threat with Oisin Murphy in the saddle ahead of Manhattan Mirage and Piazza.

  1. KALEIDOSCOPE EYES (IRE)
  2. ROSEMARY'S ROSE (IRE)
  3. MANHATTAN MIRAGE (IRE)

races.name: Dandara Homes Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ARBAAWY is still seeking his first success after 11 attempts but he's good enough to win a maiden and looks to have been found a very good opportunity with Billy Loughnane also up for the first time. Well-connected newcomers Flagbearer and Wootz could play a prominent role, especially if the market vibes are positive.

  1. ARBAAWY
  2. FLAGBEARER
  3. WOOTZ (IRE)

races.name: Golwg Gwendraeth Handicap
races.verdict:
GELATO has returned an improved model since joining Adrian Wintle and can follow up her course success off a 7 lb higher mark with that form having been well advertised since. Hurricane Laughter remains with better days ahead of him and is next on the list, although Mythological Star also needs considering on his first foray into handicaps.

  1. GELATO (IRE)
  2. HURRICANE LAUGHTER
  3. MYTHOLOGICAL STAR (IRE)

races.name: Dandara Homes Handicap
races.verdict:
Lots with chances so it could prove worth siding with GRINDLETON to bounce back in style now returned to turf and continue the excellent recent run of Daniel and Claire Kubler. Praise Indeed heads the list of dangers on the back of a very good second here, while A Daughters Love and Jimmy Mark also need factoring in.

  1. GRINDLETON
  2. PRAISE INDEED
  3. A DAUGHTERS LOVE

races.name: Army Benevolent Fund/EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WAAKABB showed plenty in a Wolverhampton maiden and can prove too sharp for well-connected newcomers A La Montagne and Stormy Winter.

  1. WAAKABB
  2. A LA MONTAGNE
  3. STORMY WINTER

races.name: Hugh James Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
ICONIC TIMES still has to prove he's as effective on turf but he doesn't need to be here, dropped to a 0-50 classified event after winning in good style off 59 at Wolverhampton on Thursday. Rain Cap is a clear next best.

  1. ICONIC TIMES
  2. RAIN CAP
  3. WAIT FOR IT (IRE)

races.name: Jacky Rylance 60th Birthday Celebration Handicap
races.verdict:
SLACK ALICE is potentially well handicapped back on the Flat given her recent improvement over hurdles so she gets the vote over Fleur De Mer and Free World, who are both lurking on career-low marks.

  1. SLACK ALICE
  2. FLEUR DE MER (IRE)
  3. FREE WORLD

races.name: Hannah Blanchard 21st Birthday Handicap
races.verdict:
CAPTAIN CESS is an improved model this season so he's taken to defy a 4 lb rise after his ready win at Thirsk. This does look competitive, though, with Barmyblade and Enjoy The Night heading the dangers.

  1. CAPTAIN CESS (IRE)
  2. BARMYBLADE (IRE)
  3. ENJOY THE NIGHT (IRE)

races.name: racingtv.com Handicap
races.verdict:
HALIMEDE can be expected to take a big step forward now handicapping/up in trip given her stable, so she gets the vote. Indeed, her likely chief rival Hansteen was beaten only by one with the same profile from the Prescott yard at Southwell 12 days ago.

  1. HALIMEDE (IRE)
  2. HANSTEEN
  3. MUHIB

races.name: Racing Again 17th August Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks between in-form pair DORALEE and Havin A Flyer, with the former shading the vote having just failed off this mark at Ripon last week.

  1. DORALEE
  2. HAVIN A FLYER
  3. MIMIME (IRE)

meeting_summary.going: Aw: standard; turf: good to firm

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Apprentice Handicap (AWT)
races.verdict:
MISTER MOJITO scored twice here in 2025 (including over C&D) and signalled he is ready to strike again when runner-up at Newmarket recently so gets the nod off the same mark here. Majestic Wave is feared most on the back of a resurgent C&D second, while Dandy Khan and Daisy Roots need factoring into this open handicap too.

  1. MISTER MOJITO (IRE)
  2. MAJESTIC WAVE
  3. DANDY KHAN (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1) (AWT)
races.verdict:
Not a strong maiden and LANGDALE LASS looks the way to go after her promising debut here on turf 3 weeks ago. Fortunate is more exposed but has place claims, while West To Rest is a newcomer to note.

  1. LANGDALE LASS
  2. FORTUNATE
  3. WEST TO REST

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2) (AWT)
races.verdict:
JAZZY BLUE shaped well from the widest draw when finding only a useful prospect of Karl Burke's too good at Wolverhampton a fortnight ago and looks the way to go. Minnal should have more to offer, while Silverella and Highland Grey are interesting newcomers.

  1. JAZZY BLUE (IRE)
  2. MINNAL
  3. SILVERELLA

races.name: John Cunliffe OBF 80th Birthday Handicap (AWT)
races.verdict:
STYLE KING has a C&D victory to his name and got back on the scoreboard at Wolverhampton last month. Still feasibly treated, he gets the nod. Federal Envoy and Just Jump can also make their presence felt.

  1. STYLE KING (IRE)
  2. FEDERAL ENVOY (IRE)
  3. JUST JUMP (IRE)

races.name: Trusted Betting Site Comparison gambling.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
TABASKO has produced her best efforts since being upped in trip on her last 2 starts, going close in a tactical race at Doncaster last time, and she is taken to get off the mark this time around. The biggest threat could come from the in-form Taritino, ahead of Scarlet Moon.

  1. TABASKO
  2. TARITINO (IRE)
  3. SCARLET MOON

races.name: Best Betting Sites At gambling.com Handicap
races.verdict:
HOPE RISING wasn't seen to best effect when running well on her Flat debut for Jamie Snowden at Bath last month and could be the answer here. Koko Blue and Gearing's Point are feared most.

  1. HOPE RISING (IRE)
  2. KOKO BLUE
  3. GEARING'S POINT

races.name: Download The At The Races App Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for D DAY MAJOR WINTER as he starts off for a yard which has had several winning stable debutants of late. From his reduced mark he gets the vote ahead of Gert Lush, who has placed twice this season having also dropped in the weights, while Monks Mead should benefit from the return to further.

  1. D DAY MAJOR WINTER
  2. GERT LUSH (IRE)
  3. MONKS MEAD

meeting_summary.going: Hurdle: good; chase: good to yielding

races.name: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday, August 29th Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
TUMBLING IN wasn't able to build on the promise of her hurdling debut effort when third at Killarney last time, though she raced freely that day so is well worth another chance as she drops back in trip. Cool Native is feared most as she returns to further, ahead of Minella Moon Shine.

  1. TUMBLING IN (IRE)
  2. COOL NATIVE (IRE)
  3. MINELLA MOON SHINE (IRE)

races.name: James Lohan Engineering Excellence Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Having looked a useful prospect in bumpers, CLAY PIGEONS was beaten at short odds on hurdling debut but he is taken to leave that effort behind given his earlier promise. He can make his second start over hurdles a winning one, at the expense of Chantilly Wings and Minella Hollow.

  1. CLAY PIGEONS (IRE)
  2. CHANTILLY WINGS (IRE)
  3. MINELLA HOLLOW (IRE)

races.name: DNG Ivan Connaughton Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Preference is for KNOCKNAGORAN LADY, who is thriving at present and remains feasibly treated in her hat-trick bid. Sound Judgement, Western Model and She'll Be Kept make up the shortlist.

  1. KNOCKNAGORAN LADY (IRE)
  2. SOUND JUDGEMENT (IRE)
  3. WESTERN MODEL (IRE)

races.name: J.F. Hanley Groundscare Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
HASHTAG PRETENDER sets the standard on his completed chase starts and has been given time to recover from his early departure at Punchestown. He looks the one to beat. Killeemore Lad and Orkneys Jack may give him most to think about.

  1. HASHTAG PRETENDER (FR)
  2. KILLEEMORE LAD (IRE)
  3. ORKNEYS JACK (IRE)

races.name: Kepak Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
Not nearly as competitive as the numbers suggest and LADIES WELL is fancied to make light of a 7 lb rise for her ready Killarney victory and make it 2-3 since switched to fences. Gaoithe Glory could emerge as the main danger sent chasing after an eye-catching fifth over hurdles at Killarney, although both Dunany Point and Island McCoo could also have a say.

  1. LADIES WELL (IRE)
  2. GAOITHE GLORY (IRE)
  3. DUNANY POINT (IRE)

races.name: Campbell's Bar Ballinlough Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
Martin Brassil's low-mileage IL SILENZIO captured this prize last year and teed himself up well for a repeat with an encouraging fourth in a big field at Punchestown on his return in June so edges the vote from Kilkee Bay who has taken well to fences and rates a big danger. Both One Way Traffic and Difficult Decision can both play a prominent role too.

  1. IL SILENZIO
  2. KILKEE BAY (IRE)
  3. ONE WAY TRAFFIC (IRE)

races.name: Brian Keenan On-Course Bookmaker Flat Race
races.verdict:
LONELYHARBOURWALL makes plenty of appeal on paper starting out in a bumper and could be the way to go before any betting clues. Lola O C and She Means Business are a couple of other interesting newcomers, with Mountain Sky perhaps the pick of those with experience.

  1. LONELYHARBOURWALL (IRE)
  2. LOLA O C (IRE)
  3. SHE MEANS BUSINESS (IRE)

Al Rayyan Cup (Prix Kesberoy) Stakes (Arab Group 1)
Prix Du Haras De La Huderie Handicap
